items.title: Canton backs a Four Pillars research programme on real-world-asset and stablecoin risks alongside MetaMask and the Solana Foundation
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)
- **Canton backs a Four Pillars research programme on real-world-asset and stablecoin risks alongside MetaMask and the Solana Foundation** — Canton has joined MetaMask and the Solana Foundation in backing a Four Pillars university research programme in Seoul, with Canton's track studying the risks of issuing large-scale real-world assets and stablecoins on public proof-of-stake chains (Canton Network Forum)
- **Copper withdraws its Canton apps from the Featured App reward programme while Wormhole's integration milestone is approved** — Copper Technologies is removing its ClearLoop Settlement and wrapped-assets apps from Canton's app reward programme, saying it will keep using them for collateral movement but wants them economically independent, while Wormhole's Canton integration milestone was approved for a weight release (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **Tokenomics Committee pauses Wintip's Featured App status after its on-chain activity is flagged for review** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee has voted to pause Featured App status for Wintip (Winsnip) on MainNet after on-chain activity was flagged for review by the Accountability Committee; because Featured App status boosts the rewards an application earns, the pause materially changes the app's economics while the review runs (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **Nine in ten investment banks expect onchain repo and collateral mobility to reshape liquidity management within five years** — A Canton Network post citing SODA's tokenization survey reports that 90% of investment banks expect onchain repo and collateral mobility to significantly reshape liquidity management within five years, the institutional use case Canton is positioning its settlement network around (Canton Network)

items.title: Bayzen is approved for Featured App status on Canton MainNet, with the decision now pending an on-chain Super Validator vote
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 1:12 PM ET)

- **Bayzen is approved for Featured App status on Canton MainNet, with the decision now pending an on-chain Super Validator vote** — The Tokenomics Committee approved Bayzen for Featured App status, which lets an application earn boosted Canton Coin rewards for the activity it drives on the network; committee approval alone does not grant the status until Super Validators confirm it on-chain, and approval is not an endorsement by the Canton Foundation (CC Space)
- **Kaiko deploys the first institutional-grade price oracle on Zenith, Canton's EVM execution layer** — The market-data provider's oracle is live on Zenith testnet now and is due in production at Zenith mainnet launch, giving EVM developers on Canton regulated multi-asset pricing data; trusted pricing is the piece market infrastructures need before accepting tokenized assets as collateral and margin (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.83% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 16:56 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.07844 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.082225 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 5.18% recorded at 12:12 PM; the widest route, buying on WEEX and selling on LBank at 4.10% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route is long MEXC perpetuals and short Lighter perpetuals at 0.01% after fees (ArbitrageGap)
- **Canton Coin perpetual open interest eases to 315 million coins as funding stays near neutral** — Open interest sits at 315 million CC, about $25.96 million, down from 323 million CC and $27.22 million recorded this morning, with average funding across eight exchanges at 0.0012%, suggesting balanced positioning between longs and shorts, and 24-hour turnover at $19.97 million (JustScreener)

items.title: Palladium Labs open-sources its Chainlink oracle kit for Canton developers, packaging the price path Alpend already uses on MainNet
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 12:42 PM ET)

- **Palladium Labs open-sources its Chainlink oracle kit for Canton developers, packaging the price path Alpend already uses on MainNet** — Version 1.0.0 of canton-oracle-kit, released on November 18 under the Apache 2.0 licence, brings together a report-verification contract, a price store and an example updater for Chainlink Data Streams reports; a pusher fetches a signed report, a Daml feeder contract calls Chainlink's verifier and checks the validity window, and the store rejects non-positive or stale prices and holds any move above a configured threshold in a pending state until a corroborating submission arrives, with the kit currently supporting V3 crypto reports on Daml SDK 3.4.11 and Canton 3.4.x and the application operator retaining authority over the verifier configuration, feed mappings and direct price writes (CantonNews)
- **Wells Fargo is among the organisations awarded new MainNet validator allocations, receiving three alongside five other operators** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group awarded the additional allocations to Wells Fargo alongside Visoty, Cartumi, Winsnip, Winnode and Otoclick, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments, in a further sign of institutional uptake of running Canton infrastructure (CC Space)
- **Three Canton applications lose Featured App status over free-traffic abuse, with the revocations now going to Super Validators** — The Tokenomics Committee, acting on the Featured App Accountability Committee's recommendation, is revoking Featured App status from Grofty Wallet, Yapper Agent and Ibex for abusing free traffic; the revocations still need on-chain approval by Super Validators, and Featured App status materially increases the Canton Coin rewards an application earns (CC Space)

items.title: Kaiko extends its Series B to $110 million, led by S&P Global with Canton also participating
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 12:12 PM ET)
- **Kaiko extends its Series B to $110 million, led by S&P Global with Canton also participating** — The market-data provider, which is a Canton Super Validator, announced the extension on September 14 with S&P Global leading and Canton joining among other strategic investors; the company describes the round as a significant investment in data and data infrastructure from institutions that lead capital markets and digital assets, and no valuation or use-of-proceeds breakdown beyond that description was disclosed in the announcement (Canton Network Forum)
- **CC Space launches its AI network explorer on Canton TestNet, with browsing open and 500 free credits on signup** — The AI-powered explorer lets users ask questions about the network based on indexed data, explore consensus, on-chain activity, governance and detailed analytics, and track validators or parties or start building with the API before MainNet; no account is needed to browse, and signing up gives 500 free credits to try the AI assistant, alerts and API (CC Space)
- **CC Space cuts alert delivery cost tenfold to 5 credits and expands triggers across more channels** — Alert deliveries fall from 50 credits to 5, about 1.5 cents per notification, with expanded triggers covering validator and Super Validator health, traffic runway, Featured App compliance, party balances and governance proposals, delivered across web, email, Telegram, Slack, PagerDuty and webhook (CC Space)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 5.18% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 17:13 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.078395 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.082455 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, widened from 5.02% recorded at 10:12 AM; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.54% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Hyperliquid at 0.24% after fees, and no route is rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: CapConnect+ enters a Canton Super Validator vote with a plan to settle commercial paper and its cash payment together on the network
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 11:42 AM ET)
- **CapConnect+ enters a Canton Super Validator vote with a plan to settle commercial paper and its cash payment together on the network** — CIP-0131, with voting open since November 10, proposes a Super Validator role for CapConnect+ with a maximum of five weight units tied to delivery and adoption, sponsored by Tradeweb and endorsed by MPCH; the first production target is at least $100 million in aggregate commercial-paper issuance with both the asset and the cash settling on Canton through delivery-versus-payment, and further weight is tied to $1 billion, $5 billion and $10 billion in cumulative Canton-settled issuance, while the platform's $46.11 billion in issuance facilitated since early 2025 used existing settlement infrastructure and is not Canton volume, and no vote outcome has been established (CantonNews)
- **Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App, with the decision now going to Super Validators for on-chain approval** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Stable Coin Inc.'s SBC application for Featured App status, which boosts the rewards an application earns for the activity it drives; the same notice confirms an additional Super Validator weight release for Canton Strategic Holdings under the Digital Asset Treasury programme, and committee approval alone does not grant the status until the on-chain vote passes (CC Space)
- **Bitget paused Canton Coin deposits and withdrawals for wallet maintenance, with no security incident or network outage reported** — A report dated November 17 says Bitget paused CC deposits and withdrawals for wallet maintenance and had not given a reopening time; the notices did not report a security incident or a Canton Network outage, so the pause limits exchange transfers without indicating a protocol problem, and users are advised to verify service status before moving tokens (CoinMarketCap)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.33 million as 24-hour DEX volume holds at $17.37 million** — DefiLlama's November 18 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.33 million, down 1.47% in 24 hours from $11.55 million recorded earlier today, with DEX volume at $17.37 million in 24 hours and $130.84 million over seven days, perps volume at $236,218, and Temple still largest at $5.99 million ahead of Alpend at $2 million and Cantex at $1.74 million across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)

items.title: Canton MainNet total transactions pass 606.2 million as validators rise to 1,572 and parties reach 951,980
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 11:12 AM ET)
- **Canton MainNet total transactions pass 606.2 million as validators rise to 1,572 and parties reach 951,980** — CCTools' live read at 16:10 UTC on November 18 puts all-time on-chain transactions at 606.20 million, up from 605.7 million recorded earlier today, with 1,572 validators alongside 13 Super Validators, 951,980 total parties and 146 Featured Apps built on Canton; the figures describe cumulative network activity and infrastructure, not trading volume (CCTools)
- **SEC staff no-action letter views Canton Coin as a digital commodity and will not recommend enforcement over its programmatic issuance under specified conditions** — The Division of Corporation Finance letter dated November 3, covered today, says staff will not recommend enforcement action over Canton Coin's programmatic issuance without securities registration under the specified conditions; the letter reflects only the staff's position on enforcement, not a legal conclusion, and rests on the facts Canton presented, and Canton's own description of the coin as "not a security" is a clause the staff reply leaves out (BSC News)
- **Morgan Stanley is reported among the first banks to use DTCC's tokenization service on Canton** — Coverage today, citing Decrypt, says Morgan Stanley says it is among the first banks to use the service DTCC launched on Canton on October 28; the service tokenizes assets custodied at DTCC, and the report gives no transaction volume or asset amount attributable to Morgan Stanley's use (BSC News)
- **Canton Coin burned over the last seven days equals 58.6% of issuance, with 109.3 million coins burned against 186.5 million issued** — CCTools' burn-and-issuance record for November 11 to 17, drawing on Loop Data, puts the burn share at 58.6% over seven days and 55.9% over 30 days, with the latest daily burn at 15.6 million CC on November 17 and app rewards at 14.7 million CC that day; issuance is what the rounds schedule, not minted supply, because unclaimed rewards are not minted (CCTools)

items.title: OpenAssets brings its markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as a DA Registry implementation partner
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 10:12 AM ET)
- **OpenAssets brings its markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as a DA Registry implementation partner** — In the November 5 collaboration with Digital Asset, OpenAssets will make its platform, which combines tokenized asset issuance, settlement, compliance, asset management and distribution in one stack, available to institutions on Canton, serving as an implementation partner for DA Registry, Digital Asset's tokenization engine; DA Registry adds allowlist, blocklist and transfer-approval controls connected to external KYC and AML providers, only the parties to a transaction can see it on Canton, and assets can take part in atomic settlement, collateral management and cross-application lending, with DA Registry already enabling more than 30 issuers and tokenization platforms on the network and no launch date or first customer disclosed (PR Newswire)
- **Canton accounts for $320.7 billion of the $366 billion in represented tokenized assets tracked on RWA.xyz** — The November 7 snapshot puts Canton far ahead of other networks on that measure, with the total almost entirely driven by Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo platform, which uses Canton technology to manage short-term repo loans backed by U.S. government bonds and reported $7.5 trillion in transaction volume for September 2026; represented assets are positions recorded on the ledger rather than freely traded onchain assets, and Finadium analysts describe Canton at this stage as a specialised record-keeping layer rather than a decentralised distribution network (RWA Signal)
- **About 79% of Canton transactions were executed privately in a 24-hour November window** — The November 14 review, drawing on CantonScan data, puts roughly 79% of transactions over the window as fully private under Daml-based smart contracts, with Digital Asset's institutional expansion supported by its $355 million June 2026 funding round and the October 2026 DTCC tokenization rollout; the figure describes the share of private execution, not total network volume (Basis Desk)

items.title: Canton Foundation opens Community Research Grants with up to 50,000 Canton Coin a month for independent research and education
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 9:42 AM ET)
- **Canton Foundation opens Community Research Grants with up to 50,000 Canton Coin a month for independent research and education** — The discretionary programme, published November 4, considers original research and educational content publicly published between November 1 and November 30, 2026 for its first round, with work shared by December 4 to be reviewed in connection with November; the Foundation may award less than the full monthly amount or nothing at all, full terms including eligibility, identity verification and sanctions screening were expected on or before November 15, and no grant will be made before those terms are published or without a signed grant agreement (Canton Foundation)
- **FTP Tech links ChatGPT and Claude to a Canton agent wallet through a hosted MCP server, with user-set spending caps** — The validator operator's Model Context Protocol server lets a user ask a chatbot to research a tokenized asset and then buy it with Canton Coin in the same conversation; in the published demo an agent swaps 100 CC into tokenized silver and ETH for a 0.01 CC fee per trade, daily and per-payment caps are set on the wallet by the user and can be changed at any time, and availability and supported assets beyond the demo have not been independently confirmed (FTP Tech)
- **Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton, dropping its invite-only access** — Anyone can now sign up, create a Canton wallet and take payments through payment links, invoices, donation pages, embeddable buttons, recurring AutoPay and a WooCommerce plugin, with a 0.1% fee on incoming payments; fiat access and Shopify support remain planned rather than live (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton Dev Fund analysis finds failed funding votes expire from absent voters, not rejections** — A community analysis of the Dev Fund repository finds seven funding votes failed with almost no votes against: they simply expired after 21 days because the 51%-of-eligible-voters threshold was never met, and four were reopened within days; it also warns that repository labels undercount failures because reopening a vote resets them (CC Space)

items.title: MEXC's Featured App status is recommended for a pause over Canton Coin locking requirements
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:42 AM ET)
- **MEXC's Featured App status is recommended for a pause over Canton Coin locking requirements** — The Tokenomics Committee has recommended pausing MEXC's Featured Application status because it does not meet the Canton Coin locking requirements introduced by CIP-0116, meaning the exchange's party stops earning featured-app rewards until it complies; the recommendation is an enforcement step under the locking rules, not a delisting of Canton Coin from the exchange (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **OpenZeppelin's Canton Daml library and four reference designs clear the Dev Fund vote** — OpenZeppelin, the smart-contract security firm recently acquired by S&P Global, has had its open-source Daml contracts library and four reference application designs for Canton — a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and one further design — approved by Digital Asset and passed by the Dev Fund committee, giving teams building financial apps on Canton vetted, reusable building blocks instead of starting from scratch (Canton Network Forum)
- **Rome Protocol launches Ostia, a zero-knowledge EVM chain settling on Canton** — Rome Protocol has put Ostia live on Canton DevNet as an Ethereum-compatible chain whose blocks are proved with zero-knowledge proofs and settled in a single Canton transaction, with a bridge that moves Canton Coin and ERC-20 tokens between the two sides; the code is open source, so Solidity developers can now deploy to a chain that settles on Canton, and the launch is on DevNet, not MainNet (Canton Network Forum)
- **DTCC plans to connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027, with a Stellar connection planned for the first half** — The service launched on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network on October 28 and runs under agreements with 20 participants, and the November 15 expansion plan was characterised as a multichain strategy rather than a move away from Canton, so Canton remains the first live venue while the other connections are future work (CoinStats)

items.title: Further Asset Management is approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first at that tier with a dedicated Middle East presence
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)
- **Further Asset Management is approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first at that tier with a dedicated Middle East presence** — Further announced today that existing Super Validator operators approved it under CIP-0113, giving it a formal governance role in the Global Synchronizer and a Super Validator node linking the UAE ecosystem; the firm says the move takes it from capital provider to active network operator, one of a small number of non-bank institutional validators on Canton, and Digital Asset chief executive Yuval Rooz said Further brings a live portfolio of companies that will generate real transaction volume on the network (Further Asset Management)
- **Canton's governance locks move from votes to code as CIP-0127 sets out on-chain enforcement of validator and app lock-ups** — The Canton Network Docs describe a governance lock as a Canton Coin holding locked to meet the requirements set by CIP-0105 for Super Validators and CIP-0116 for Featured Apps, with CIP-0127 as the functional specification defining the lock lifecycle and wallet workflows; governance locks are available from Splice 0.10.0 onwards, its first two increments are included in that release, every lock must hold at least 10,000 CC, and until custom controllers arrive all Super Validator rights owners and Featured App providers must use the compatibility mode the proposal defines (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton's on-chain governance record stands at 573 executed proposals against 45 rejected, a 93% approval rate** — CCTools' governance data as of 12:10 UTC on November 18 puts the network's cumulative record at 573 executed and 45 rejected proposals, with total Canton Coin supply at 40.07 billion CC derived from the protocol itself; the figures are a cumulative governance snapshot, not a count of votes held today (CCTools)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 6.96% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 06:25 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.078731 and dearest on XT at $0.08421 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, widened from the 5.57% spread recorded earlier today; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on Bitget at 6.75% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route is long MEXC perpetuals and short Lighter perpetuals at 0.08% after fees (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton Index milestone votes seek acceptance for tools that turn ledger records into data applications can query
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 7:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Index milestone votes seek acceptance for tools that turn ledger records into data applications can query** — Canton Index, a project from The Graph Foundation and InfraDAO, has votes open on two parts of its work: milestone 1, covering tools for defining and testing filters that select the records an application needs, and milestone 2, covering a pipeline that processes new ledger records and keeps an application's stored data up to date; each milestone carries 444,000 CC, for a combined 888,000 CC, the first milestone is returning to review after an earlier vote did not pass, with revised documentation and responses to design feedback in its resubmission, its source code remains private with publication planned by milestone 4, and neither vote had established acceptance or payment at the reporting cutoff, so these are votes on acceptance of submitted work rather than a new award for the whole project (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin rises nearly 5% in 24 hours to about $0.084 in the latest market coverage** — Coverage published on November 18 puts Canton Coin at about $0.084, up nearly 5% over 24 hours on CoinGecko data, with the move attributed in that coverage to regulatory relief and tokenization momentum; the token remains well below its all-time high of $0.1942, and the gain is a price move reported today rather than a new network announcement (BSC News)

items.title: Progmat partners with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton for round-the-clock settlement
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 6:12 AM ET)
- **Progmat partners with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton for round-the-clock settlement** — The collaboration aims to settle the bonds in programmable token form on a 24/7 basis while preserving their legal rights; Progmat leads Japan's security token issuance market by value handled, and the initiative runs through a working group with 367 members that began live testing in November to build a sandbox for issuing tokenized government bonds and stablecoins, so the work is at the testing stage rather than a live government-bond issuance (Coin Newsify)
- **TSV completes its first transaction under the SEC innovation exemption, settling tokenized Canton Strategic Holdings shares on Canton** — The November 4 transaction moved issuer-sponsored tokenized shares of Canton Strategic Holdings through a permissioned pool on Tradecraft and settled them on Canton, with Fairmint, an SEC-registered transfer agent, handling the shares and maintaining on-chain ownership records; TSV describes itself as the first United States tokenized stock trading platform operating under the exemption, and the structure removed the 30-day notice period usually required for third-party tokenization (Coin Newsify)
- **Canton Development Fund approves RedStone's CAPS proposal to set a privacy standard for shared pricing data** — The Canton Access and Privacy Standard, approved on September 16, carries a 12-month development plan budgeted at 15.775 million Canton Coin, about $1.83 million, to let institutions use the same reference prices while keeping their own transaction terms confidential; the first implementations involve design partners Zenith and Memora, with Memora focusing on proof of reserves, so the standard is funded and in development rather than deployed network-wide (Cointelegraph)
- **Cancore raises $7.2 million to scale its Liquidity OS for tokenized finance after settling $86 million on Canton MainNet** — The seed round values the Canton-based trading platform at a $60 million token valuation and drew Paper Ventures, dao5, ArkStream Capital, X Ventures, MH Ventures and Proof of Talk, with no formal lead investor and Paper Ventures and dao5 as the largest contributors; the $86 million settled figure is the platform's own reported MainNet total (The Block)

items.title: DamlFuzz funding vote seeks a free, open-source tool to test Daml contracts for authorisation and privacy failures before users find them
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 5:42 AM ET)
- **DamlFuzz funding vote seeks a free, open-source tool to test Daml contracts for authorisation and privacy failures before users find them** — The vote, opened on November 14, would fund a fuzzer that tries many inputs and sequences of actions against contracts written in Daml, Canton's smart-contract language, checking rules about who can authorise an action and which parties can see the data; the proposed tool would run locally and fit into developers' regular testing, and the vote opening is a proposal stage, not an approved grant or a live tool (CantonNews)
- **Party-Aware Daml Upgrade and Vetting Planner vote opens to check an application update before it changes a running system** — The separate November 14 vote would combine checks on software packages, dependencies and permissions into a reviewable plan, with vetting meaning declaring which application packages a participant supports; the proposed first version would inspect one participant and produce a plan without making changes itself, flagging gaps where information is missing rather than treating the whole network as ready (CantonNews)
- **Supanova launchpad liquidity roughly doubles in its first week even as trading volume cools sharply from launch day** — AlphaMemeRadar's review of Supanova, which opened Canton's first memecoin launchpad on November 3, puts its liquidity page on November 11 at 5 pools loaded and $496.9K in total value locked, up from about $247,600 on November 4, while 24-hour volume fell about 95% to 451K CC from 9.73 million CC the day after launch; every trade on the launchpad runs against Canton Coin, tokens trade on a bonding curve with no gas fees and graduate into a liquidity pool, and the review notes a listing or graduation is not an endorsement or a safety check (AlphaMemeRadar)
- **Canton Coin rebounds from its November 17 low in the latest daily history, rising to $0.08346 from $0.07937** — TrackLivePrice's November 18 daily history, based on CoinGecko data, puts Canton Coin at $0.08346, up from $0.07937 recorded for November 17 and below $0.08260 for November 16, with the move described in the latest snapshot as up 3.82% in 24 hours and down 5.97% over seven days; the daily rows are snapshots, not a forecast (TrackLivePrice)

items.title: Kann Audits proposes two Canton security projects, covering independent audits of core components and AI-assisted scanning of Daml code
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 5:12 AM ET)
- **Kann Audits proposes two Canton security projects, covering independent audits of core components and AI-assisted scanning of Daml code** — The two applications, submitted on November 14, seek assignments within the existing audit programme for independent audits of core components, with no new allocation requested and any work drawing on that programme's approved budget subject to selection, and the Canton Coin equivalent of $45,000 over nine months for an AI-assisted Daml security scanner that would include a catalogue of security weaknesses, developer-tool integration and three months of free access for each Canton team with a researcher reviewing its first scan; both applications still list a need for a champion to support them through the process, so they are proposals, not approved grants or audit appointments (CantonNews)
- **National Bank of Cambodia is testing tokenized government bonds on Canton in an SBI Holdings proof of concept** — The test, reported on November 18 with interim results due at the Black Swan Summit on November 15 to 16, is separate from a yen stablecoin remittance trial, and service details and timing remain under discussion, so the work is a proof of concept rather than a live government-bond issuance on the network (CoinStats)
- **Canborsa adds Anthropic-linked markets to its perpetuals venue, listing leverage of up to 10 times for both new tickers** — The ANT and ANTH markets announced on November 13 let traders take a position on price movements without owning Anthropic shares, with leverage amplifying losses as well as gains, and add another category of exposure to a venue that already supports Canton Coin as collateral (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 5.57% apart across exchanges, with no spot route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 10:14 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.07952 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.083952 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, changed from 4.23% recorded on November 15, with the widest spot route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.82% after fees, flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route long Toobit and short Hyperliquid at 0.09% after fees (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Stratalink Labs launches its Proof of Liquidity oracle on Canton MainNet, recording signed assessments of market depth on the ledger
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)
- **Stratalink Labs launches its Proof of Liquidity oracle on Canton MainNet, recording signed assessments of market depth on the ledger** — The PoLi Oracle, published November 17, scores secondary-market order-book depth observed directly from trading venues, with each score cryptographically signed and recorded on Canton as a point-in-time attestation that authorised parties can verify; the initial deployment covers Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and Canton Coin across two venues, IntellectEU built the Daml smart contract layer and the deployment runs on a validator provisioned through CatalyX Blockchain Manager with an on-ledger compliance check; PoLi measures market depth, not reserve backing or redemption access, so a fully backed asset can still score poorly if its markets are thin, and founder Robert McDermott confirmed institutional pilot discussions are at an early stage with no institutions yet using the system, making the launch a technical milestone rather than a commercial one (Unlock Blockchain)
- **Canton DeFi locked value holds at $11.55 million as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $17.6 million** — DefiLlama's November 18 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.55 million, with DEX volume at $17.6 million in 24 hours, up from $16.66 million recorded on November 15, $130.84 million over seven days and perps volume at $238,049 (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Foundation publishes CIP-0103, the dApp Standard defining a common interface between applications and wallets** — The standard, published on November 17 and listed as Approved on the Standards Track, introduces a vendor-neutral dApp API that decouples network connectivity and key management from decentralised applications, so users can access any application with a validator and signing provider of their choice while wallets enforce authorisation against malicious requests from untrusted applications (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton Coin derivatives show no new buying behind the latest price gain, with open interest down and funding neutral** — CoinStats' November 18 read puts futures open interest at $36.04 million, down 1.24% over two days and 19.78% over 30 days and below the $40.35 million period average, with funding neutral at 0.0008%, 24-hour liquidations of only $3.11K almost entirely on long positions, and 24-hour volume of $12.68 million described as thin against the market cap, with no dated price-specific announcement found in the past 24 hours (CoinStats)

items.title: ChainSafe now runs the Canton DevNet endpoints OpenZeppelin uses to build and test its Daml contract libraries
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 3:42 AM ET)
- **ChainSafe now runs the Canton DevNet endpoints OpenZeppelin uses to build and test its Daml contract libraries** — ChainSafe announced on November 16 that it will deploy, operate and maintain the DevNet API endpoints for OpenZeppelin, covering smart-contract package upload endpoints and Ledger API read and write access, so OpenZeppelin can deploy its Daml libraries and tooling and test them against a live network as it expands its Contracts library and reference implementations to Canton; ChainSafe is itself a Canton Super Validator, and the arrangement is DevNet testing infrastructure, not a MainNet application launch or a completed security audit (ChainSafe)
- **CIP-0132, the first technical paymaster model for Universal Burn, moves from discussion draft to a formal vote** — The proposal opened for voting on November 16, with Digital Asset as Super Validator sponsor and Five North as endorser, and sets out three steps for dedicated synchronizers: measure the synchronizer's traffic, have a designated paymaster burn Canton Coin after that traffic is consumed, and record activity that can qualify for rewards; this first phase still relies on the operator and paymaster to report usage accurately and does not yet enforce traffic limits, and the vote opening is not approval or deployment of the model, which builds on the already-approved Universal Burn framework in CIP-0129 (CantonNews)
- **Alpend gives ONE its own protocol identity as Adula, separating issuance from its private lending platform** — Palladium Labs introduced Adula on November 16 as the home for ONE, its privacy-native collateralized debt position protocol issuing ONE against collateral on Canton, while Alpend continues to focus on private lending and borrowing; the underlying mechanics are unchanged and each protocol now has its own identity and governance path, public minting of ONE against Canton Coin remains listed as coming soon, and swaps between USDCx and ONE remain available only in its open private beta (CantonNews)
- **Canton maintainers are testing a recovery runbook for validators that fell out of consensus after the MainNet Logical Synchronizer Upgrade** — A November 16 maintainer update says a small percentage of active MainNet validator nodes were unprepared for the most recent Logical Synchronizer Upgrade, having missed the minimum Splice version, and fell out of consensus; maintainers are sharing a finalized recovery procedure with a small number of validator operators to validate it and correct any unclear documentation, and planned to revisit progress the next morning US Eastern, after which a validated runbook would be posted publicly and added to the official Disaster Recovery documentation; the update does not say all affected validators have recovered (Canton Network Forum)

items.title: Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 3:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time** — The Nasdaq-listed company (CNTN) reported on November 16 total revenue of $3,051,232 for the quarter ended September 30, up 104% from $1,495,859 in the second quarter, in its first full quarter of Super Validator and locking-as-a-service operations; network validation revenue rose to $1,503,238 as active Super Validator weight climbed from 0.5 to 6.5 of 15 approved, other revenue was $1,547,994, mostly locking-as-a-service, and adjusted EBITDA was $610,414 against a loss of $820,449 in the second quarter, while a $54.65 million unrealized loss on its digital-asset holdings drove a net loss of $35,078,297 (PR Newswire)
- **Nomura, NRI and BOOSTRY set out a joint plan to connect financial firms to onchain markets on Canton** — In their November 16 announcement, NRI is developing a service that captures blockchain transactions and balances in real time into its I-STAR securities back-office systems, BOOSTRY says its Canton-first institutional wallet entered production in September and that it has completed a protocol connecting Canton to its ibet for Fin digital-securities platform, and the three intend to examine government and corporate bonds, shares and funds from issuance through settlement and collateral use; the collaboration is still under consideration and builds on the single shared Super Validator arrangement approved under CIP-0130, with up to 10 reward weight in total (CantonNews)
- **Total Canton Coin burned passes 6.13 billion as fee burns run at about four coins for every five minted** — CantonScan data put the cumulative burn at 6.13 billion CC as of November 16, up from 6.05 billion recorded on November 15, with about $1.15 million worth burned in the 24 hours to November 16; because new CC is minted as rewards, burns at roughly 80% of minting mean supply still grows modestly rather than contracting, against about 40 billion CC in circulation (BSC News)
- **Splice release notes reach version 0.10.2, upgrading Canton to 3.7.3 and removing the last CometBFT support** — The 0.10.2 notes add CIP-104 v1.1 featured-asset activity fields to Scan event responses, add governance support for the amended traffic-based reward calculation, and remove the remaining CometBFT endpoints, metrics and charts from the Super Validator app; the release train follows the MainNet upgrade to Splice 0.10.0 that was listed for November 16 (Canton Network Docs)

- **Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time** — The Nasdaq-listed company (CNTN) reported on November 16 total revenue of $3,051,232 for the quarter ended September 30, up 104% from $1,495,859 in the second quarter, in its first full quarter of Super Validator and locking-as-a-service operations; network validation revenue rose to $1,503,238 as active Super Validator weight climbed from 0.5 to 6.5 of 15 approved, other revenue was $1,547,994, mostly locking-as-a-service, and adjusted EBITDA was $610,414 against a loss of $820,449 in the second quarter, while a $54.65 million unrealized loss on its digital-asset holdings drove a net loss of $35,078,297 (PR Newswire)
- **Nomura, NRI and BOOSTRY set out a joint plan to connect financial firms to onchain markets on Canton** — In their November 16 announcement, NRI is developing a service that captures blockchain transactions and balances in real time into its I-STAR securities back-office systems, BOOSTRY says its Canton-first institutional wallet entered production in September and that it has completed a protocol connecting Canton to its ibet for Fin digital-securities platform, and the three intend to examine government and corporate bonds, shares and funds from issuance through settlement and collateral use; the collaboration is still under consideration and builds on the single shared Super Validator arrangement approved under CIP-0130, with up to 10 reward weight in total (CantonNews)
- **Total Canton Coin burned passes 6.13 billion as fee burns run at about four coins for every five minted** — CantonScan data put the cumulative burn at 6.13 billion CC as of November 16, up from 6.05 billion recorded on November 15, with about $1.15 million worth burned in the 24 hours to November 16; because new CC is minted as rewards, burns at roughly 80% of minting mean supply still grows modestly rather than contracting, against about 40 billion CC in circulation (BSC News)
- **Splice release notes reach version 0.10.2, upgrading Canton to 3.7.3 and removing the last CometBFT support** — The 0.10.2 notes add CIP-104 v1.1 featured-asset activity fields to Scan event responses, add governance support for the amended traffic-based reward calculation, and remove the remaining CometBFT endpoints, metrics and charts from the Super Validator app; the release train follows the MainNet upgrade to Splice 0.10.0 that was listed for November 16 (Canton Network Docs)

items.content_text:

items.title: SEC staff no-action relief for Canton Coin is narrow, covering only the programmatic minting described in Digital Asset's October 30 request
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 5:42 PM ET)
- **SEC staff no-action relief for Canton Coin is narrow, covering only the programmatic minting described in Digital Asset's October 30 request** — A detailed breakdown of the November 3 response says Division of Corporation Finance staff viewed Canton Coin as a digital commodity under the agency's March interpretation and would not recommend enforcement over the specified programmatic minting by Super Validators, Validators and application providers under Section 5 of the Securities Act and Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act; it is a staff position, not a court ruling, a Commission-wide conclusion or a blanket exemption, it does not approve secondary-market trading, every distribution method, other tokens built on Canton or every financial product using the network, and different facts could lead staff to a different conclusion, with the request resting on representations that the network has no central party and that the token launched without an initial coin offering or premine (Bitcoin Foundation)
- **Canton's institutional adoption score rises to 78 out of 100, ranked third of 27 in TokenSonar's latest update** — TokenSonar's update published November 15 at 20:34 UTC puts Canton at 78/100 and rank #3, up from 75/100 and rank #5 recorded earlier today, ahead of Quant at 62/100 and rank #13, with both classed as Bank Infrastructure and carrying 10 tracked institutional signals each, Canton's tracked partners including Goldman Sachs, BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, Société Générale, DTCC and JPMorgan Chase, and Canton listed with live spot ETF status against none for Quant; scores update twice daily from regulatory filings, named bank deployments, ETF flows and on-chain real-world-asset data, not price action (TokenSonar)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.70% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 22:45 UTC on November 15 puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.080252 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.08402 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, changed from 5.23% recorded at 4:12 PM; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.14% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.62% after fees, and all 16 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Kintsu builds vaults on Canton's party-only visibility model, so depositors see where capital can go while curator rebalances stay private
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 4:12 PM ET)
- **Kintsu builds vaults on Canton's party-only visibility model, so depositors see where capital can go while curator rebalances stay private** — A November 15 wire item says that on Canton a contract is visible only to the parties required to see it, and Kintsu is building vaults on that model, so depositors can see where capital can go while a curator's rebalances stay out of public view; it describes the vault design and its privacy model, not a live vault launch (CantonNews)
- **Uber's tokenized money market fund pilot on Canton shows weekend access to cash when traditional markets are closed** — Tekedia's November 15 coverage of the October 30 pilot says Uber used HSBC tokenized deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares through Tradeweb, with Fireblocks providing wallet infrastructure and Canton facilitating settlement by delivery-versus-payment, and liquidated part of the holding over a weekend; it remains a pilot, not a deployed global treasury system, and the participants have not disclosed the transaction value (Tekedia)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.53 million as 24-hour DEX volume slips to $16.89 million** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.53 million, down 2.39% in 24 hours, with DEX volume at $16.89 million, down from $17.34 million recorded at 2:12 PM, perps volume at $237,710, Temple still largest at $6.21 million ahead of Alpend at $1.9 million, Cantex at $1.77 million and Tradecraft at $1.46 million, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 5.23% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 21:17 UTC on November 15 puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.079149 and dearest on XT at $0.08329 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, changed from 5.36% earlier today; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.59% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.58% after fees, and all 15 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton trading volume falls 10.1% to about $24.6 million as EDELx leads the day's gains
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 3:12 PM ET)
- **Canton trading volume falls 10.1% to about $24.6 million as EDELx leads the day's gains** — CantonCap's 18:00 UTC read on November 15 puts total 24-hour trading volume across the Canton Network at about $24.6 million, down 10.1% from about $27.3 million a day earlier, while liquidity at the five reporting venues rose 1.6% to $5.53 million; EDELx posted the largest gain among coins with at least $50,000 of volume at +26.2% to about $0.0135, cSOL led decliners at -4.7%, CBTC traded about $11.1 million, Temple reported $20.8 million of venue volume, and the Canton Ecosystem Fear and Greed Index fell to 8 out of 100, in extreme fear, from 13 a day earlier (CantonCap)
- **Altus joins the Canton Foundation to contribute institutional integration expertise** — Altus, the blockchain engineering company formerly known as B-Harvest, was spotlighted by the Foundation on November 15; it plans to share implementation experience in internal controls, compliance and system integration, placing engineers inside client organisations to design infrastructure that fits existing systems, with work spanning validator operations, tokenization, trading and stablecoin payments and settlement — a membership spotlight following its inclusion in the Foundation's November 4 introduction, not a new product launch (CantonNews)
- **Fairmint SDK is on the way to bring Privy sign-in users onto Canton** — A November 15 wire item says the Fairmint SDK is coming and is meant to bring users who sign in with Privy onto Canton with the login they already use; it is an announced software kit in development, not a live release (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin spot prices widen to 5.36% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 20:27 UTC on November 15 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.079265 and dearest on Gate at $0.083515 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, widened from 3.87% earlier today; the widest route, buying on WEEX and selling on OKX at 4.95% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.27% after fees, and all 18 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: DTCC's production tokenization on Canton points to a credit layer as the next chapter
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **DTCC's production tokenization on Canton points to a credit layer as the next chapter** — An analysis in today's digest argues settlement was only the first layer after DTCC processed its first live production trades with tokenized U.S. Treasury and equity securities on July 15, 2026, through existing production workflows, with the securities staying at DTC while digital twins settled on a production environment that included Canton; the piece says the next phase is privacy-preserving credit, where tokenized assets serve as collateral and unlock liquidity without leaving custody, naming Alpend as the Canton venue building that layer ahead of the DTCC Tokenization Service's ongoing rollout (CantonNews)

items.title: Canton keeps issuance and settlement as separate jobs, unlike a single public ledger
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 1:12 PM ET)
- **Canton keeps issuance and settlement as separate jobs, unlike a single public ledger** — A Five North analysis in today's digest argues every securities market separates the issuer, who creates the claim, from the settlement layer, noting DTC custodies more than $100 trillion in securities and issues none of them; on Canton the issuing party's node controls the asset and its rules, synchronizers operated by other parties sequence and finalize transactions without holding or reading their contents, disclosure is selective, and settlement is still atomic across counterparties, with the stated tradeoff being the permissionless public composability of a single-ledger chain (CantonNews)
- **Silvana offers private trading on Canton, with orders matched away from public view and settled by delivery-versus-payment** — Silvana Book is a live private orderbook for tokenized assets: orders are matched privately, assets stay in the user's wallet with no escrow until the final trade settles on Canton, and the platform offers direct swaps, private requests for quote, grid strategies and permissioned trading agents; V2 adds a redesigned Trading Terminal, support for Lattice Wallet and an updated EarnHub for campaigns and settled-trade rewards (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.58% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 18:42 UTC on November 15 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.079285 and dearest on Gate at $0.082915 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, changed from 4.84% earlier today; the widest route, buying on WEEX and selling on LBank at 4.12% after fees, is flagged with an unverified transfer, and the best futures route, long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.66% after fees, is rated risky, with 16 routes in profit all rated risky (ArbitrageGap)
- **Flicker's daily read puts Canton Coin at Hold, with a sideways trend and oversold momentum** — The November 15 read at 18:15 UTC puts the trend sideways at 16 of 100, RSI at 34 for oversold, its Fear and Greed gauge at 33 for fear and risk at 69 of 100, with a Hold verdict from four of six factors; the price sits inside buy zone B1 at $0.07666 to $0.08364, with nearest support at $0.05862 and nearest resistance at $0.08680, and 24-hour volume at $16.57 million, flat (Flicker)

items.title: Canton releases version 3.7.3, focused on sequencer stability, traffic accounting and party replication
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 12:12 PM ET)
- **Canton releases version 3.7.3, focused on sequencer stability, traffic accounting and party replication** — The release on November 12 addresses the sequencer that orders transactions, how traffic is accounted for, and party replication; it is a software release note, not a MainNet upgrade completion (CoinStats)
- **Cauri Wallet users now pay network fees in Canton Coin when sending assets** — The change announced on November 11 shifts who pays the fee: the network fee itself already existed, and what changed is that Cauri Wallet users now pay it in CC when sending assets (CoinStats)
- **Canton Strategic chief warns extractable value could leave tokenized stock investors paying hidden trading costs** — Chief executive Mark Wendland warned that maximum extractable value, where traders or operators influence transaction ordering for profit, can leave other users with worse prices; he said Canton is designed to prohibit it, with privacy preventing universal visibility of orders and validators unable to accept payments to change their position in the sequence (CryptoCompass)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.84% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 17:17 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on WEEX at $0.079085 and dearest on KuCoin at $0.08291 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market; the widest route, buying on WEEX and selling on OKX at 4.17% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.64% after fees, and all 15 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 11:42 AM ET)
- **Canton Coin has no cliff unlock scheduled, with 52.89% of supply still locked under linear vesting** — Tokenomist's November 15 update, last updated at 16:51 UTC, puts unlocked supply at about 48.89 billion CC, or 47.11% of projected 2035 supply, with the rest released gradually under the vesting schedule rather than in a single cliff; allocations are App Reward Share at 50.87%, Super Validator Reward Share at 34.00% and Validator Reward Share at 15.13%, and the token has no fixed maximum supply (Tokenomist)
- **Canton scores 75 out of 100 for institutional adoption against Quant, ranked fifth of 27** — TokenSonar's comparison published November 15 puts Canton at 75/100 and rank #5 against Quant at 62/100 and rank #13, with both classed as Bank Infrastructure and carrying 10 tracked institutional signals each, and Canton listed with live spot ETF status against none for Quant; scores update twice daily from regulatory filings, named bank deployments, ETF flows and on-chain real-world-asset data, not price action (TokenSonar)
- **Canton DeFi locked value rises to $11.54 million as 24-hour DEX volume stands at $17.57 million** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.54 million, up from $11.31 million recorded at 8:12 AM, down 2.36% in 24 hours, with perpetuals volume at $237,333 in 24 hours and $1.89 million over seven days, Temple still largest at $6.2 million ahead of Alpend at $1.9 million and Cantex at $1.78 million, across eight protocols (DefiLlama)

items.title: Cantex adds optional two-factor authentication for actions that move assets or grant permissions
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 10:42 AM ET)
- **Cantex adds optional two-factor authentication for actions that move assets or grant permissions** — The wallet update covers withdrawals, transfers, pre-approvals and bridge transactions, adding another check beyond the initial sign-in that users can choose to apply to those actions; it is an optional setting, not a mandatory change for all accounts (CantonNews)
- **The Hub reports 1,000 members on Canton, combining creator content with tradable community tickets** — The Hub says its platform combines creator content, live rooms and tradable community tickets on Canton and has announced 1,000 members; the figure is a milestone reported by the project itself and follows an earlier SprintFAM creator-network partnership, although the posts do not establish how many sign-ups came from that collaboration (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin spot prices widen to 4.88% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 16:06 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.078756 and dearest on OKX at $0.082602 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, widened from 4.61% recorded at 9:12 AM; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on OKX at 4.26% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.68% after fees, and all 18 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)
- **Canton perpetuals are flagged as shorts crowded, with negative funding as open interest eases** — GetCoinSight's November 15 read at 16:02 UTC flags Canton CC as shorts crowded, with CC at $0.08255, funding at -0.0439% on an 8-hour equivalent basis and open interest across four venues at $29.2 million; crowded short positioning is a positioning label from the screener, not a forecast of a squeeze (GetCoinSight)

items.title: About 79% of Canton transactions were executed privately over a 24-hour window in November
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 10:12 AM ET)
- **About 79% of Canton transactions were executed privately over a 24-hour window in November** — Basis Desk's November 14 summary, drawing on Decrypt and CantonScan data, puts about 79% of updates across a 24-hour period in November as fully private, with participating nodes storing only data relevant to their leg of a transaction and Super Validators ordering encrypted state changes without accessing transaction payloads; it is a privacy-share snapshot from an explainer summary, not a new launch (Basis Desk)
- **Tritemius expands its iOS wallet through TestFlight, adding Canton assets and two Lightning options** — The update adds support for cETH from onRails, HANDL from HandlPay and Edel's tokenized stock and index products labelled AAPL, MSTR, QQQ and SPY, plus a one-click Lightning option that needs no personal node and a personal-node option using Tritemius as controller; availability is through TestFlight, not a confirmed general App Store release, and the Lightning options do not mean Lightning transactions settle on Canton (CantonNews)
- **R13N's Canton Reward Engine gets a fresh funding vote, for up to 3,636,363.64 CC** — The reopened vote covers software to help applications calculate and distribute rewards funded by campaign sponsors; the previous vote closed without passing after receiving no binding votes, which is different from members voting against it, and approval remains pending (CantonNews)
- **MEXC's Featured App status is recommended for pause over Canton Coin locking requirements** — The Tokenomics Committee has recommended pausing MEXC's Featured Application status because it does not meet the Canton Coin locking requirements introduced by CIP-0116, meaning the exchange's party stops earning featured-app rewards until it complies; it is a committee recommendation reported November 12, not a delisting of Canton Coin from the exchange (CC Space)

items.title: Progmat signs with Digital Asset to build tokenized Japanese government bonds on Canton, with live testing starting this month
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 9:12 AM ET)
- **Progmat signs with Digital Asset to build tokenized Japanese government bonds on Canton, with live testing starting this month** — The memorandum of understanding announced November 10 will build tokenized Japanese government bonds, called tJGB, that keep the legal status of ordinary book-entry bonds; the first phase connects Progmat's issuance platform to Canton and to Japan's existing book-entry transfer register, a working group of more than 68 organizations formed in May begins live testing this month, and MUFG with three affiliates will test bond-for-cash settlement and the full repo lifecycle, with 24/7 programmable settlement as a target rather than a finished product; Progmat already handles 51 of Japan's 103 disclosed security-token deals, about ¥290.6 billion of ¥470.3 billion issued (Genfinity)
- **Temple trades $15.6 million in 24 hours as Canton's largest spot venue, with an 88.8% share of spot volume** — The November 15 read at 14:24 UTC puts Temple first of four venues across five markets, led by CBTC/USDCx at $7 million, followed by BETH/USDCx at $2.5 million, CC/USDCx at $2.4 million, eXAU/USDCx at $2 million and eXAG/USDCx at $1.7 million (Canton Venues)
- **Canton Coin spot prices widen to 4.61% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 13:36 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.078279 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.08189 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, widened from 4.16% recorded at 8:12 AM; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on OKX at 4.06% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.61% after fees, and routes in profit carry caveats with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest stands at $35.81 million as 24-hour liquidations reach $207,700, almost entirely longs** — CoinGlass puts open interest down 1.72% in 24 hours, with futures volume at $28.29 million, about 2.1 times spot volume of $13.67 million, tracked liquidations at $207,700 including $205,890 in longs against $1,820 in shorts, and an open-interest-weighted funding rate of -0.0213%, with shorts paying longs (CoinGlass)

items.title: Obsidian Systems' Python tools for Canton application teams pass their vote and are merged
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)
- **Obsidian Systems' Python tools for Canton application teams pass their vote and are merged** — The 1.27 million CC proposal would generate Python classes from compiled Daml packages, saving developers from recreating those contract definitions by hand; the plan includes delivery and a year of maintenance, and passing and merging is not yet a delivered tool (CantonNews)
- **Edel reports about $300,000 in stolen EDEL tokens, with the tokens sold or blocked by exchanges** — Edel reported the theft on November 12 and said it was working with authorities and exchanges to investigate, with all the stolen tokens either sold or blocked and a detailed post-mortem promised; it gave no breakdown between the two outcomes, and the notices do not identify the affected wallets or establish that Canton's network or Edel's other products were compromised (CantonNews)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.31 million as 24-hour DEX volume slips to $18.25 million** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts total value locked down 4.28% in 24 hours, down from $11.42 million recorded at 6:42 AM, with DEX volume at $18.25 million, down from $18.71 million, perps volume at $240,509, Temple still largest at $6.06 million ahead of Alpend at $1.87 million, Cantex at $1.75 million and Tradecraft at $1.44 million, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.16% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 13:17 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on WEEX at $0.07847 and dearest on OKX at $0.081736 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 4.39% recorded at 7:42 AM; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 3.65% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.62% after fees, and all 17 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton Coin futures open interest eases to $35.16 million as 24-hour liquidations jump to $342,350
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 6:42 AM ET)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest eases to $35.16 million as 24-hour liquidations jump to $342,350** — Coinfuty's live read puts open interest down 7.84% in 24 hours at $35.16 million, with futures volume up 65.47% to $28.73 million and liquidations up 573.23% to $342,350, almost entirely longs at $340,530 against $1,820 in shorts; the aggregate long/short ratio stands at 0.665, the open-interest-weighted funding rate at -0.0129%, and Bybit carries the largest book at $11.16 million, about 32% of the total ahead of Binance at $10.47 million (Coinfuty)
- **Zenith joins co-sponsors backing IBC's move to neutral Linux Foundation governance** — Zenith is among the co-sponsors supporting IBC's contribution to the Linux Foundation's decentralized trust work, alongside individuals from Wells Fargo, Figure Markets, OpenZeppelin, Partior and the Cardano Foundation; Zenith says IBC is already integrated into Zenith Testnet, laying groundwork for cross-chain communication and asset transfers extending beyond the Canton ecosystem, and notes IBC has facilitated more than $50 billion in transaction volume across more than 200 networks (CantonNews)
- **Canton DeFi locked value stands at $11.42 million in the latest snapshot** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.42 million, down 3.32% in 24 hours, up from the $11.32 million recorded at 6:12 AM, with Temple still largest at $6.09 million ahead of Alpend at $1.88 million, Cantex at $1.73 million and Tradecraft at $1.43 million, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 3.22% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 11:55 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.07809 and dearest on OKX at $0.080608 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 3.32% recorded at 6:12 AM with a different cheapest/dearest pair; the best transfer route, buying on MEXC and selling on Kraken at 0.84% after fees, has unknown transfer status, and all 32 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton's governance runs through a single open CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 6:12 AM ET)
- **Canton's governance runs through a single open CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date** — CantonNews' guide to the Canton Improvement Proposal process sets out five proposal categories covering technical standards, governance, tokenomics, process and informational items, open to any public author with no gatekeeping, moving through drafting and working-group review to sponsorship by two Super Validators, a 10-day Super Validator vote requiring a two-thirds supermajority with no single-entity veto, and on-chain implementation through DevNet, TestNet and MainNet before Final status; cited examples include CIP-0056 on the token standard, CIP-0078 eliminating Canton Coin transfer fees and CIP-0117 introducing Logical Synchronizers (CantonNews)
- **MainNet upgrade to Splice 0.10.0 is listed for November 16** — The Canton Foundation calendar entry carried in CantonNews' November 15 digest lists the MainNet upgrade to Splice 0.10.0 for November 16, with the digest noting the time as still to be confirmed; it is a scheduled upgrade listing, not a completed upgrade (CantonNews)
- **Canton DEX volume eases to $18.71 million in 24 hours as perpetuals volume slips to $240,189** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts DEX volume at $18.71 million, down from $19.21 million recorded at 4:42 AM, with perps volume at $240,189, down from $241,982, total value locked at $11.32 million, down 4.20% in 24 hours, Temple still largest at $6.09 million ahead of Alpend at $1.88 million, Cantex at $1.73 million and Tradecraft at $1.43 million, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices narrow to 3.32% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 11:22 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on WEEX at $0.07805 and dearest on OKX at $0.080644 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 4.77% recorded at 3:42 AM; the widest route, buying on WEEX and selling on OKX at 3.04% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.58% after fees, and all 15 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton Index returns for milestone review, with two votes each carrying 444,000 CC
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 2:42 AM ET)
- **Canton Index returns for milestone review, with two votes each carrying 444,000 CC** — The project from The Graph Foundation and InfraDAO, which aims to turn Canton ledger records into data applications can query more easily, has votes open on milestone 1, covering tools for defining and testing filters that select the records an application needs, and milestone 2, covering a pipeline that processes new ledger records and keeps stored data up to date, for a combined 888,000 CC; these are votes on acceptance of submitted work, not a new award for the whole project, the first milestone is returning after an earlier vote did not pass with revised documentation and responses to design feedback, its source code remains private with publication planned by milestone 4, and neither vote had established acceptance or payment at the reporting cutoff (CantonNews)
- **Party-Aware Daml Upgrade and Vetting Planner vote opens to check an application update before it changes a running system** — The separate November 14 vote would combine checks on software packages, dependencies and permissions into a reviewable plan, with vetting meaning declaring which application packages a participant supports; the proposed first version would inspect one participant and produce a plan without making changes itself, flagging gaps where information is missing rather than treating the whole network as ready (CantonNews)
- **Canton DeFi locked value stands at $11.34 million as 24-hour DEX volume eases to $19.55 million** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts total value locked down 4.00% in 24 hours, with perps volume at $242,271 over 24 hours and $1.89 million over seven days, Temple still largest at $6.12 million ahead of Alpend at $1.86 million, Cantex at $1.74 million and Tradecraft at $1.43 million, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices widen to 4.89% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 08:10 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.076435 and dearest on KuCoin at $0.080175 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.20% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.64% after fees, and all 17 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: The Tie puts Canton's year-to-date Canton Coin burn at 4.49 billion
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 1:42 AM ET)
- **The Tie puts Canton's year-to-date Canton Coin burn at 4.49 billion** — The figure covers January 1 to November 11, 2026, and counts Canton Coin burned to pay traffic fees on the Global Synchronizer, the shared service that coordinates Canton application transactions; it is a year-to-date total and does not by itself measure the net change in supply, which also depends on newly minted rewards (CantonNews)
- **OpenZeppelin's Canton library and four app designs pass development-fund review** — The open-source contracts library implementing Canton's Token Standard V2 (CIP-0112) is available now under the MIT licence and has been tested together on LocalNet, while designs for a private exchange with atomic settlement, a lending market, cross-chain stablecoin payments and confidential sealed-bid auctions move toward implementation; the library has not yet been audited, with security audits planned for the next phase, and the designs are reference specifications, not live applications (CantonNews)
- **Canton perpetuals volume eases to $242,842 in 24 hours as spot DEX volume holds at $20.13 million** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts perps volume at $242,842 over 24 hours and $1.89 million over seven days, down 69.86% on the week, against DEX volume of $20.13 million in 24 hours and $137.56 million over seven days, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices narrow to 3.87% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 07:08 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.077188 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.080173 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 3.38% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short MEXC at 0.54% after fees, and all 15 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: DamlFuzz funding vote opens to test Daml contracts for authorization and privacy failures before users find them
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 12:42 AM ET)
- **DamlFuzz funding vote opens to test Daml contracts for authorization and privacy failures before users find them** — A funding vote opened on November 14 on a free, open-source fuzzer that tries many inputs and sequences of actions against contracts written in Daml, Canton's smart-contract language, checking rules about who can authorise an action and which parties can see the data; the proposed tool would run locally and fit into developers' regular testing, and the vote opening is a proposal stage, not an approved grant or a live tool (CantonNews)
- **SBI and Cambodia's central bank tokenized-bond trial reaches its Black Swan Summit demonstration window** — The November 13 memorandum's next checkpoint is November 15–16 in Phnom Penh, where SBI plans to present interim findings with a demonstration, and the summit agenda includes a November 16 session on widening investment access that explicitly describes an onchain government-bond transfer demonstration using Canton; the National Bank of Cambodia will register and manage bondholder information, SBI Bank (Cambodia) will work on technical verification of tokenization and transfers, and SBI Digital Practice will build and operate the trial environment — a planned proof of concept, not live issuance (CantonNews)
- **Canton app fees stand at $8,074 in 24 hours as app revenue reaches $7,159** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts token incentives at $1.64 million in 24 hours, down from $1.79 million recorded earlier, with 24-hour DEX volume at $20.13 million and $137.56 million over seven days, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.28% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 06:13 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.076445 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.079718 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 3.79% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short MEXC at 0.60% after fees, and all 15 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

- **DamlFuzz funding vote opens to test Daml contracts for authorization and privacy failures before users find them** — A funding vote opened on November 14 on a free, open-source fuzzer that tries many inputs and sequences of actions against contracts written in Daml, Canton's smart-contract language, checking rules about who can authorise an action and which parties can see the data; the proposed tool would run locally and fit into developers' regular testing, and the vote opening is a proposal stage, not an approved grant or a live tool (CantonNews)
- **SBI and Cambodia's central bank tokenized-bond trial reaches its Black Swan Summit demonstration window** — The November 13 memorandum's next checkpoint is November 15–16 in Phnom Penh, where SBI plans to present interim findings with a demonstration, and the summit agenda includes a November 16 session on widening investment access that explicitly describes an onchain government-bond transfer demonstration using Canton; the National Bank of Cambodia will register and manage bondholder information, SBI Bank (Cambodia) will work on technical verification of tokenization and transfers, and SBI Digital Practice will build and operate the trial environment — a planned proof of concept, not live issuance (CantonNews)
- **Canton app fees stand at $8,074 in 24 hours as app revenue reaches $7,159** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts token incentives at $1.64 million in 24 hours, down from $1.79 million recorded earlier, with 24-hour DEX volume at $20.13 million and $137.56 million over seven days, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.28% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 06:13 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.076445 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.079718 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 3.79% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short MEXC at 0.60% after fees, and all 15 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)
