items.title: Canborsa adds Anthropic-linked perpetual markets with up to 10x leverage
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 12:12 AM ET)
- **Canborsa adds Anthropic-linked perpetual markets with up to 10x leverage** — The ANT and ANTH markets, announced November 13 on Canborsa Perps, let traders take positions on price movements without a fixed expiry and do not give ownership of Anthropic shares; leverage can amplify losses as well as gains, and the venue already supports Canton Coin as collateral (CantonNews)
- **Kann Audits proposes two Canton security projects, including AI-assisted Daml scanning** — The November 14 applications seek assignments for independent audits of core components within the existing audit programme, with no new allocation requested, and the CC equivalent of $45,000 over nine months for AI-assisted Daml security scanning with a weakness catalogue, developer-tool integration and three months of free access for each Canton team; both still need a champion and are proposals, not approved grants or audit appointments (CantonNews)
- **Cantex trades $1.6 million in 24 hours as Canton's largest AMM by volume** — The November 15 read at 05:34 UTC puts Cantex at 129,100 swaps in 24 hours across 25 CC pools, with $2.1 million in liquidity, 23 tokens holding $1,000 or more of liquidity and an 8.2% share of spot volume; its largest pool is CC/USDC.B at $507K (Canton Venues)
- **Canton DeFi locked value stands at $11.31 million in the November 15 snapshot** — DefiLlama puts total value locked down 4.26% in 24 hours, with 24-hour DEX volume at $20.12 million and $137.56 million over seven days, Temple still largest at $6.1 million ahead of Alpend at $1.85 million, Cantex at $1.74 million and Tradecraft at $1.43 million, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.14% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 05:37 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.076815 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.079995 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 3.79% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Bybit at 0.55% after fees, and all 15 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton Coin spot prices narrow to 3.75% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 10:42 PM ET)
- **Canton Coin spot prices narrow to 3.75% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 04:12 UTC on November 15 puts CC cheapest on MEXC at $0.076403 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.079271 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 4.14% earlier today; the best spot route, buying on MEXC and selling on Kraken, pays 1.77% after taker fees, about $31 on $1,761 at the best book prices, with transfer status unknown and the route rated risky, and none of the 23 routes in profit is rated take (ArbitrageGap)
- **Visa, Franklin Templeton, LSEG and Shinhan anchor Canton's recent Super Validator wave** — Decrypt's November 14 guide lists Visa joining as a Super Validator in March 2026, Franklin Templeton in August and the London Stock Exchange Group appointed in September, the same month Shinhan Asset Management became the first Korean financial institution approved as one, with custody firm Fireblocks also adding support for Canton (Decrypt)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.03 million as daily DEX volume holds at $20.62 million** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts total value locked down 6.63% in 24 hours, with Temple still largest at $6.0 million ahead of Alpend at $1.76 million and Cantex at $1.69 million, perpetuals volume at $243,364 and token incentives easing to $1.64 million in 24 hours (DefiLlama)
- **Flicker's latest read lifts Canton Coin out of extreme fear, with RSI back at 30 after a 5.8% hourly bounce** — The November 15 read at 03:30 UTC puts the 14-candle RSI at 30, still strongly oversold, its Fear and Greed gauge at 28 for fear, up from 23 for extreme fear earlier today, the trend sideways at 16 of 100 and risk at 73 of 100, with a Hold verdict from four of six factors and the price inside a conflicting $0.07676 to $0.08354 zone (Flicker)

items.title: One week on Canton, in three numbers: 63 Super Validator nodes, 6.07 billion CC burned to date and $1.44 million in daily network fees
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 10:12 PM ET)
- **One week on Canton, in three numbers: 63 Super Validator nodes, 6.07 billion CC burned to date and $1.44 million in daily network fees** — CantonNews' November 14 weekly summary, citing the Canton Foundation Live Counter with data from The Tie, puts the network at 63 Super Validator nodes with total Canton Coin burned reaching 6.07 billion, up from the 6.04 billion recorded earlier today, and daily network fees at $1.44 million on the public blockchain with privacy built in (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest eases to $34.85 million as 24-hour liquidations reach $342,500, almost entirely longs** — CoinGlass' latest aggregated read puts open interest at $34.85 million, down 8.73% in 24 hours, with futures volume at $28.42 million, about 2.1 times spot volume of $13.69 million, tracked liquidations at $342,500 including $341,500 in longs against $1,000 in shorts, and an open-interest-weighted funding rate of -0.0071% (CoinGlass)
- **Canton app fees rise to $8,246 in 24 hours as app revenue reaches $7,345** — DefiLlama's November 15 snapshot puts application fees at $8,246 over 24 hours, up from $7,829 recorded earlier today, with app revenue at $7,345, up from $6,866, alongside token incentives of $1.79 million over 24 hours and inflows of $0 (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin slips 5.81% in 24 hours to $0.07975, extending its seven-day decline to 11.66%** — CoinGlass' latest price read puts CC at $0.07975 with a 24-hour range of $0.07479 to $0.08576, down 11.66% over seven days and 58.9% below its all-time high of $0.1943 set on February 3, 2026, a move the read links to long positions closing rather than a Canton-specific event (CoinGlass)

items.title: CertiK's audit of Cancore's Canton settlement contracts closed with 12 of 15 findings resolved
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 8:42 PM ET)
- **CertiK's audit of Cancore's Canton settlement contracts closed with 12 of 15 findings resolved** — The audit, delivered November 3, 2026, used manual review and static analysis across four audited files including FeeConfig.daml and HTLC.daml, with formal verification passing three of three properties for the HTLC contract; the remaining three findings were acknowledged and none were left partially resolved, and Cancore is the non-custodial settlement layer that trades Canton assets against public chains without wrapped tokens or custodial bridges (CertiK)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.14% apart across exchanges, with still no route worth taking** — A live scan at 02:11 UTC on November 15 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.074225 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.077296 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 4.39% earlier today; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on OKX at 3.62% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route, long WhiteBIT and short Hyperliquid at 0.70% after fees, is rated risky (ArbitrageGap)
- **Flicker's daily read puts Canton Coin strongly oversold, with RSI at 25 and sentiment in extreme fear** — The November 14 read at 23:30 UTC puts the 14-candle RSI at 25, its Fear and Greed gauge at 23 for extreme fear, the trend sideways at 14 of 100 and risk at 73 of 100, with a Hold verdict from four of six factors; the price sits 0.5% below distribution zone D1 at $0.07673 to $0.08357, with nearest support at $0.05862 and nearest resistance at $0.08680 (Flicker)
- **Cancore's development pace stays high, with 53 GitHub commits in the week of November 2** — The commit count follows 77 commits in the week of October 26 and 151 in the week of October 19, a sustained build pace for the Canton settlement platform in the weeks after its $7.2 million seed round (CertiK)

- **Live MainNet rewards jump to 13.8 million Canton Coin in 24 hours as total burned reaches 6.04 billion** — CantonNews' live November 14 counter puts rewards well above the 12.0 million recorded earlier today, with current activity at 1.00 transactions per second, total transactions at 603.0 million and total parties at 946.8K (CantonNews)

items.title: Societe Generale accepts $10 million in tokenized US Treasuries as eligible collateral on Canton
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)
- **Societe Generale accepts $10 million in tokenized US Treasuries as eligible collateral on Canton** — The bank's Prime Services and Clearing division completed the controlled transaction on November 2 using Treasuries tokenized in the soft launch of DTCC's Tokenization Service, showing the tokens can transfer onchain and be reflected in the bank's existing back-office and collateral systems within its governance, risk and control framework; the bank plans recurring collateral movements and, over time, onchain repo financing, building on its first US tokenized bond issuance on Canton in November 2025 and its Super Validator role announced in May 2026 (Societe Generale via The Asian Banker)
- **Morgan Stanley pushes its tokenized equity venue Trajectory Cross to the first quarter of 2027, citing thin demand** — The bank confirmed it is among the first banks to use DTCC's Tokenization Service even as its own venue slipped from the second half of 2026, citing limited product availability and thin institutional demand; it is still building wallet infrastructure, and its head of digital asset strategy frames the long-term tokenized asset market at $3 trillion to $10 trillion by 2030 (EX.IO)
- **Versana's loan data platform on Canton covers roughly $3.5 trillion in commitments across more than 6,000 facilities** — The syndicated loan platform is among the largest live data workloads on the network, sitting alongside the London Stock Exchange Group's DiSH platform, which uses tokenized bank deposits as the cash leg of repo and ran the first tokenized Gilt repo in early 2026 (Medium)
- **Canton Coin spot prices narrow to 4.39% apart across exchanges, with still no confirmed route worth taking** — A live scan at 00:11 UTC on November 15 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.07373 and dearest on Bitget at $0.07697 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 8.06% earlier today; the best spot route, buying on MEXC and selling on Kraken, pays 2.01% after taker fees on only $378 at the best book prices with the transfer status unknown, and no route with a confirmed open transfer is rated worth taking (ArbitrageGap)

Network: CC $0.07665 | Market cap $3.07B | 24h volume $16.89M | Supply 40.05B CC; milestone: more than 150 live or emerging applications now run on the network (CoinDataFlow for market data; Medium for the milestone)

items.title: Canton's first tokenized stock debut drew five buys and no sells, with $40,296 changing hands on day one
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 6:12 PM ET)
- **Canton's first tokenized stock debut drew five buys and no sells, with $40,296 changing hands on day one** — Coindoo's tally of TSV LLC's public trading feed shows five purchases of Canton Strategic Holdings' tokenized CNTN shares on November 4 delivered 18,680 shares for $40,296, an average of $2.16 a share, with per-share prices climbing from $2.08 to $2.37 and the last $10,000 purchase executing after Nasdaq's regular close; Five North sold existing shares, DRW Cumberland was the named buyer behind the first purchases and Flowdesk supplied liquidity, buyers paid in USDCx, and no holder sold into the pool — the pool prices from its own reserves on the Tradecraft automated market maker rather than from Nasdaq's quote, and the SEC order bars primary issuance on the venue, so none of the $40,296 reached the issuer (Coindoo)
- **OpenAssets deploys its markets-in-a-box platform on Canton, issuing tokenized assets through the DA Registry** — The Pittsburgh-based infrastructure provider's November 5 partnership with Digital Asset lets institutional clients issue and manage their own tokenized assets on Canton using Digital Asset's DA Registry, plugging tokenization into established compliance and custody frameworks instead of requiring firms to build from scratch; the terms of the partnership were not disclosed (Moneyaviro)
- **CIP-0130 passes with 11 votes in favour, approving a single Super Validator framework for Nomura Group and BOOSTRY** — The proposal, passed November 10 with two non-votes, gives Nomura Group and BOOSTRY one shared Super Validator participation framework with up to 10 in reward weight earned through verified milestones, extending the milestone-based model already used for other large institutional operators on the network (CoinStats)
- **Canton Coin falls 10.97% in 24 hours to $0.07585, extending its seven-day decline to 19.17%** — CoinGlass' latest aggregated read puts CC at $0.07585 with a 24-hour range of $0.07525 to $0.08601, a move the read attributes to broad market weakness rather than a Canton-specific event, leaving the coin well below the $0.089 area it traded near earlier in the week (CoinGlass)

Network: CC $0.0766 | Market cap $3.1B (rank 27) | 24h volume $15.2M | Supply about 40.02B CC; milestone: more than 55 institutions serve as Super Validators on the Global Synchronizer, including Visa, which joined in March 2026 with the highest voting weight (Altcoin Buzz for market data; Medium for the milestone)

items.title: SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin stays in focus as coverage weighs its limits
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 4:42 PM ET)
- **SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin stays in focus as coverage weighs its limits** — Fresh coverage of the November 3 response notes that staff in the SEC's Division of Corporation Finance viewed Canton Coin as a digital commodity under the facts presented by Digital Asset and would not recommend enforcement action over programmatic minting by Super Validators, Validators and application providers if the stated conditions are followed, covering registration provisions under Section 5 of the Securities Act and Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act; the coverage stresses the limits — the response is a staff position rather than a Commission action, expresses no legal conclusion, relies on Digital Asset's representations and does not address secondary-market trading of CC (ad-hoc-news)
- **Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo, derivatives and private assets** — Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz, speaking in an X Space, put tokenized stocks at the top of the network's sequence after the first trades under the SEC's Innovation Exemption — Canton Strategic Holdings' issuer-sponsored tokenized common stock traded on TSV LLC, announced November 4 — with more firms expected to join repo trading on Canton this year and derivatives and a wider range of private assets to follow; for corporate adoption he cited Uber's treasury pilot, run by HSBC, Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks on Canton, as the model for bringing in non-financial companies (BSC News)
- **LayerZero links with Canton to support cross-chain asset transfers for institutional users** — LayerZero has integrated its interoperability protocol with the Canton Network to enable cross-chain transfers, connecting Canton to an interoperability ecosystem LayerZero puts at more than $100 billion in value; the network is built by Digital Asset, whose backers include Goldman Sachs, Microsoft and DTCC, and which confirmed nearly 400 ecosystem participants now engage with Canton (BitRss)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.32 million even as daily DEX volume holds above $20 million** — DefiLlama's November 14 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.32 million, down 6.46% over 24 hours, with 24-hour DEX volume at $20.79 million and seven-day DEX volume at $139.07 million, up 4.77% on the week; Temple remains the largest protocol at $6.18 million locked, ahead of Alpend at $1.8 million and Cantex at $1.72 million (DefiLlama)

Network: CC $0.0767 | Market cap $3.08B (rank 27) | 24h volume $14.49M | Supply 40.05B CC; milestone: the network was burning roughly 80% as much CC each day as it minted as of November 2026, below the 1:1 ratio at which supply would start to shrink, with every CC in circulation minted as a reward and no pre-mine or venture allocations (Kriptometre for market data; CVJ for the milestone)

items.title: Goldman Sachs is proposed as a Super Validator on Canton under a milestone-based programme
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 4:12 PM ET)
- **Goldman Sachs is proposed as a Super Validator on Canton under a milestone-based programme** — A governance CIP, authored by Abeetha Pitigala and currently in Proposed status, would designate Goldman Sachs and Co. as a Canton Super Validator with a maximum earnable weight of 10 under a programme agreed with the Canton Foundation; weight is earned incrementally as ecosystem commitments are met, rewards do not mint until milestones are verified, unearned weight tied to missed deadlines is removed, and approval requires a two-thirds Super Validator vote, with specific milestones and timelines remaining confidential until Goldman Sachs and the Foundation agree on disclosure (CC Privacy Club)
- **TreasurySpring's Canton plan wins approval with a $5 billion outstanding target for its fund shares** — The plan, approved September 9, targets $5 billion in outstanding fund shares and $20 billion in cumulative issuance within 12 months, starting with $10 million outstanding and $15 million cumulative issuance at three months and reaching $1 billion outstanding by month six; Canton will hold ownership records for the fund shares, TreasurySpring can earn a maximum Super Validator reward weight of four with evidence that targets are reached and maintained for a month, and it already operates a Canton validator (CC Privacy Club)

items.title: Decrypt's November 14 explainer puts Canton's September snapshot at about 60 Super Validators and more than 120 applications
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 3:42 PM ET)
- **Decrypt's November 14 explainer puts Canton's September snapshot at about 60 Super Validators and more than 120 applications** — The explainer, summarised November 14, cites Digital Asset reporting as of September 30 that Canton had about 60 Super Validators run by 13 Super Validator node operators, more than 700 Validators and over 120 applications, with applications processing more than $6 trillion in tokenized real-world assets including over $350 billion in daily U.S. Treasury repo on company-reported figures; the Global Synchronizer, live since July 2024, orders and confirms transactions under a two-thirds Byzantine Fault Tolerant threshold without reading their contents, and governance sits with the Global Synchronizer Foundation hosted by the Linux Foundation (CoinStats)
- **An over-the-counter swap on Canton references a tokenized investment-grade bond index** — S&P Dow Jones Indices, Kaiko and Derivnex announced the swap as a Canton-based trade referencing the tokenized index, an example of derivatives building on tokenized bonds rather than on a spot crypto asset; the announcement does not give a trade size or confirm recurring volume (CoinStats)
- **Pool Party, Canton's first automated market maker, holds $192,834 in locked value after a 25.1% fall over 30 days** — The Send Foundation venue, launched in February 2026 and accessed through the Send Canton Wallet, shows a November 14 daily snapshot of $196,016, cumulative DEX volume of $4.8 million against only $28,409 over the last 30 days and $95.17 in fees over 30 days, down from an all-time high of $1.03 million in locked value on June 3 (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest falls to $35.10 million as liquidations rise to $231,840, all of it on the long side** — Coinfuty's latest aggregated read puts open interest at $35.10 million, down 9.75% in 24 hours, with futures volume at $20.15 million, up 13.00%, tracked liquidations at $231,840 entirely in longs against $8.75 in shorts, an open-interest-weighted funding rate of -0.0151% over four hours and an aggregate long-to-short ratio of 0.673; Bybit holds the largest book at $11.37 million, about 32% of the total, ahead of Binance at $10.33 million (Coinfuty)

items.title: CertiK's audit of Digital Asset's Canton registry off-chain utilities found no critical or high issues
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 3:12 PM ET)
- **CertiK's audit of Digital Asset's Canton registry off-chain utilities found no critical or high issues** — The security assessment, carried out in July 2026 by three CertiK reviewers and published in final form on August 21, covered the Canton Network Off-Chain Utilities frontend and backend at version 0.12.15, including utility APIs, the active registry and credential workflows, operator automation, contract archival and reward processing; it recorded 12 findings in total — four Medium, all acknowledged, six Low, with one resolved and five acknowledged, and two Informational, both acknowledged — mainly around authentication and authorization gaps, information disclosure and backend resource handling, and testing found no bypass of Daml's on-ledger authorization model and no practical exploit chain from the off-chain weaknesses to unauthorized ledger actions (CertiK)
- **Marex's hosted Super Validator arrangement takes effect on MainNet, with its host node's reward weight rising from 35 to 45** — The MainNet governance record shows MPCH's reward weight increasing from 35 to 45 on October 7 to accommodate Marex's weight-10 program under CIP-0126, approved September 25; rewards accumulate in the Unclaimed Rewards Pool and are released only against verified milestones covering regulated customer access, institutional settlement, collateral integration and production activity, with Marex required to present evidence and a Canton Coin calculation for each milestone, and once it has been awarded more than 2.5 in weight it must operate its own Super Validator within six months (CantonNews)
- **Canton holds fourth place for institutional adoption in TokenSonar's updated comparison with XRP** — TokenSonar's live comparison, published November 14, puts Canton at 78 of 100 and ranked fourth, ahead of XRP at 71 of 100 and ranked seventh, with both networks tracked on 10 institutional signals each, both classed as Bank Infrastructure and both with a live spot ETF; the scores update twice daily from regulatory filings, named bank deployments, ETF flows and on-chain real-world asset data rather than price action, and Canton's tracked partners include Goldman Sachs, BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, Société Générale, DTCC and JPMorgan Chase (TokenSonar)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest falls to $35.64 million as liquidations stay almost entirely on the long side** — Coinfuty's latest aggregated read puts open interest at $35.64 million, down 8.67% in 24 hours, with futures volume at $19.82 million, up 16.07%, tracked liquidations at $220,950 of which $220,940 were longs against only $8.75 in shorts, an open-interest-weighted funding rate of -0.0072% and an aggregate long-to-short ratio of 0.681; Bybit holds the largest book at $11.54 million, about 32% of the total, ahead of Binance at $10.44 million (Coinfuty)

items.title: Canton documentation sets out three ways wallets and exchanges can support USDCx, Circle's Canton stablecoin
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)
- **Canton documentation sets out three ways wallets and exchanges can support USDCx, Circle's Canton stablecoin** — The support page, updated November 12, explains that Circle and Digital Asset partnered to implement a USDC token on Canton: users send USDC on Ethereum to Circle's xReserve contract and the token is created on Canton as a CIP-56 standard token representing USDC locked on the original chain, while a withdrawal burns the token on Canton and releases the asset on Ethereum, currently the only supported destination; wallets and exchanges can simply transfer and hold USDCx with any CIP-56 support, add xReserve deposits and withdrawals through a custom API integration, or integrate the xReserve interface directly into the wallet for a full end-to-end experience (Canton Network Docs)
- **Kraken enables deposits and withdrawals of USDCx on Canton, giving exchange users a route into the stablecoin** — Kraken's announcement says USDCx is backed one-to-one by USDC held in Circle's xReserve, with an equivalent amount minted on Canton when USDC is deposited into xReserve on Ethereum; the support creates a bridge between exchange users and Canton's privacy-enabled institutional settlement environment, though liquidity for USDCx trading pairs is not yet fully active and will depend partly on market makers and institutional usage (BitRss)
- **Canton Coin futures funding flips negative, with shorts now paying longs** — CoinGlass' latest read puts the open-interest-weighted funding rate at -0.0145%, about -15.9% annualised, a reversal from the small positive rates recorded earlier today, while total futures open interest stands at $35.93 million, tracked liquidations total $220,720 almost entirely on the long side at $220,710 against only $8.75 in shorts, and futures volume of $20.36 million runs at about 2.3 times spot volume of $8.78 million (CoinGlass)
- **USDCx led trading among Canton's listed assets in the October market read, ahead of Canton Coin itself** — CantonCap's November 1 read put combined 24-hour volume across its 15 listed Canton assets at about $47.4 million, led by USDCx at $20.02 million against $4.22 million for Canton Coin, with USDCx priced at $1.002 for a fully diluted valuation of $6.80 million; the month was broadly lower, with 14 of the 15 assets down over 30 days and HANDL the only gainer, up 0.2% (CantonCap)

- **Digital Asset's funding for Canton totals $415 million across three rounds, including a $10 million extension that added Shinhan and SC Ventures** — DefiLlama's Canton chain page puts total raised at $415 million: the $355 million round of June 11, 2026 led by a16z crypto, a $10 million extension on July 21, 2026 whose investors were Shinhan Venture Capital and SC Ventures, and a $50 million strategic round on December 4, 2025 backed by BNY Mellon, Nasdaq Ventures, iCapital and S&P Global; the totals describe capital raised by Digital Asset, the network's creator, not funds held by the network itself (DefiLlama)
- **Live MainNet activity jumps to 19.00 TPS as rewards over the last 24 hours reach 12.0 million CC** — CantonNews' live MainNet counter on November 14 reads current activity at 19.00 TPS, up sharply from the 1.00 TPS recorded earlier today, with rewards over the last 24 hours at 12.0 million CC, up from 11.3 million earlier today, and total Canton Coin burned rising to 6.04 billion from 6.03 billion; the TPS figure is a live snapshot that moves minute to minute, not a sustained average (CantonNews)
- **Temple's cumulative fees reach $527,926, with $597.78 million of DEX volume over 30 days** — DefiLlama's Temple page puts the Canton DEX's cumulative fees and revenue at $527,926, with $224,169 of fees in the last 30 days and $597.78 million of DEX volume over the same period, taking cumulative DEX volume to $2.029 billion; locked value stands at $6.16 million, below the $7.45 million all-time high set on November 3, so the fee milestone reflects trading throughput rather than growth in locked capital (DefiLlama)
- **The reported SBI and Cambodia central bank bond test on Canton still has no primary announcement behind it** — Genfinity's review of the reported memorandum of understanding between SBI Holdings and the National Bank of Cambodia to test tokenized government bonds on Canton found no primary announcement from SBI, the central bank or Canton, and no signing date, bond volume or timeline in the ecosystem roundup that carried the story; the reported plan describes a pilot, not a live issuance, and which bonds the test would use and whether it would cover issuance, settlement or secondary trading all remain unconfirmed (Genfinity)

items.title: Canton chain fees run at about $7,675 a day, a steady usage baseline even as market sentiment stays cold
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Canton chain fees run at about $7,675 a day, a steady usage baseline even as market sentiment stays cold** — Crypheat's November 14 read puts daily chain fees at about $7,675, which it treats as a proxy for real demand for block space on Canton, while its composite heat score for Canton Coin sits at 5, labelled COLD, with the price down 26.0% over the past 30 days; the fee pace points to continuing network use underneath the weak price action, and the heat score is a composite sentiment gauge, not a network fundamental (Crypheat)
- **Canton Coin spot prices narrow to 8.06% apart across exchanges, with still no arbitrage route worth taking** — ArbitrageGap's live scan at 6:43 PM UTC on November 14 puts the cheapest spot price on WEEX at $0.074775 and the dearest on Kraken at $0.080805 across 12 liquid spot exchanges, a spread narrowed from 9.06% earlier today, with no route rated worth taking after fees and the best futures route, long WhiteBIT and short Hyperliquid, at 0.71% after taker fees and flagged risky (ArbitrageGap)
- **Canton perpetuals volume holds near a quarter-million dollars as spot DEX volume carries the chain's trading** — DefiLlama's November 14 chain read puts perpetuals volume at $250,741 over 24 hours and $1.93 million over seven days, down 73.39% on the week, against spot DEX volume of $20.56 million in 24 hours and $139.07 million over seven days, up 4.77%, with DEX-versus-CEX dominance at just 0.07% (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin sits inside a defined buy zone on the daily chart, with trend still sideways** — Flicker's November 14 daily analysis, written at 4:45 PM UTC, places the price inside buy zone B1 at $0.07691 to $0.08339, scores the trend sideways at 13 of 100 with a risk score of 72 of 100, and puts the nearest support at $0.05862, 27.4% below, and the nearest resistance at $0.08680, 7.4% above; the read is a Hold with four of six factors agreeing, and is analysis, not advice (Flicker)

items.title: CertiK ranks Canton first among compared blockchains for third-quarter fees, at more than $155 million
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 1:12 PM ET)
- **CertiK ranks Canton first among compared blockchains for third-quarter fees, at more than $155 million** — CertiK's Skynet monitoring platform recorded more than $155 million in Canton fees between July and September, the highest in its comparison, with a median daily pace of $1.71 million pointing to a high baseline rather than a few peaks; the figure measures Canton Coin burned for network services, because fees are priced in dollars per megabyte of Global Synchronizer traffic, and should not be read as revenue, while CertiK did not disclose which blockchains were in its comparison or publish issuance data alongside it (ETHNews)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest eases to $35.82 million as liquidations reach $220,140, almost entirely longs** — Aggregated open interest fell 7.32% in 24 hours to $35.82 million, with futures volume at $19.65 million and tracked liquidations at $220,140, of which $220,000 were long positions and only $138 were shorts; positioning still leans short with an aggregate long-to-short ratio of 0.675, and Bybit holds the largest book at $11.68 million, about a third of the total, ahead of Binance at $10.49 million (Coinfuty)
- **Current Canton traffic burns already offset 69% of new issuance, Alea Research modelling finds, up from 11% a year ago** — The modelling puts the offset at 69% of new token issuance, up from 11% a year earlier, with September's newly minted Canton Coin going 73% to top-performing applications and 14% to Super Validators, and a theoretical break-even price of $0.0752 calculated against the 648.5 million CC minted in September; adding about one-third more traffic burn to current levels would reach full balance in the model, which is a simulation, not a network result (TechFlow)
- **Splice release notes list 0.10.2 upgrading Canton to 3.7.3, after 0.10.1 moved to Canton 3.7.2** — The current Splice release line in the Canton documentation shows 0.10.2 upgrading the underlying Canton release to 3.7.3 and 0.10.1 upgrading it to 3.7.2 with a base-image update, while 0.10.0 notes that Canton release 3.7 adds support for protocol version 37 and requires a Logical Synchronizer Upgrade to adopt it (Canton Network Docs)

items.title: DTCC's plan to add Solana in 2027 puts Canton inside a broader multi-chain tokenization strategy
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 12:42 PM ET)
- **DTCC's plan to add Solana in 2027 puts Canton inside a broader multi-chain tokenization strategy** — DTCC announced on November 12 that it plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027, describing the move as part of a multi-chain strategy to let assets move between traditional infrastructure and several blockchain networks; the service launched on October 28 operating initially with the Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network, with 20 DTC participants signed at launch, so Canton is the network already integrated while the Solana connection is a future expansion, and the announcement does not establish a direct valuation measure for Canton Coin (ad-hoc-news)
- **A paymaster draft sets out the first technical step toward Universal Burn on dedicated synchronizers** — The draft, announced for discussion on November 10, would have a dedicated synchronizer record its traffic in ten-minute intervals and a designated paymaster burn the corresponding Canton Coin on the Global Synchronizer afterward, with validator and app reward eligibility recorded through the paymaster and Super Validators registering the synchronizer, its paymaster and its activity-weight limits; the first version trusts operators to report traffic correctly, remains a draft under governance review, and establishes no final pricing curve or deployment date (CantonNews)
- **Canton DeFi locked value falls to $11.41 million, down 5.74% in 24 hours, as DEX volume edges up** — DefiLlama's November 14 chain read puts total value locked at $11.41 million, down from $11.5 million earlier today, with Temple at $6.17 million, Alpend at $1.86 million, Cantex at $1.74 million and Tradecraft at $1.44 million, while 24-hour DEX volume rose slightly to $20.56 million from $20.51 million (DefiLlama)
- **Live MainNet rewards over the last 24 hours climb to 11.3 million CC** — CantonNews' live MainNet counter on November 14 shows rewards over the last 24 hours at 11.3 million CC, up from 9.9 million recorded earlier today, with current activity at 1.00 TPS, alongside total transactions at 603.0 million, total parties at 946.8K, total burned at 6.03B CC, about 1.6K validators, 13 Super Validators and 6 active proposals (CantonNews)

items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 11:12 AM ET)
- **Canton perpetuals volume falls to $251,675 in 24 hours as spot DEX volume holds above $20 million** — Perpetuals trading on Canton has slowed sharply, with $251,675 in volume over the last 24 hours and $1.93 million over seven days, a weekly change of -73.39%, while spot DEX volume held at $20.51 million over 24 hours and $139.07 million over seven days, up 4.77% on the week (DefiLlama)
- **About 79% of Canton updates were fully private in a November 24-hour window, CantonScan data shows** — Network explorer data cited in new coverage of Digital Asset's institutional rollout puts the fully private share of updates at approximately 79% over a 24-hour window in November 2026, reflecting Canton's Daml-based sub-transaction privacy, under which participating nodes only receive the data relevant to their own leg of a transaction (Basis Desk)
- **Canton DeFi locked value falls to $11.5 million, down 4.94% in 24 hours** — Total value locked across Canton's eight tracked DeFi protocols fell to $11.5 million, with Temple at $6.2 million, Alpend at $1.89 million, Cantex at $1.76 million and Tradecraft at $1.46 million; the figures are down from $11.74 million locked earlier today (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin futures positioning leans short, with an aggregate long-to-short ratio of 0.658** — Positioning across tracked venues leans toward shorts, with an aggregate long-to-short ratio of 0.658 and OI-weighted funding at -0.0017% over four hours; Bybit holds the largest futures book at $12.35 million, about 32% of the $38.44 million total, ahead of Binance at $11.02 million (Coinfuty)

items.title: Sixty-seven companies object to OKXICE's third-party tokenization plans, putting issuer consent at the centre of the SEC exemption debate
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 10:42 AM ET)
- **Sixty-seven companies object to OKXICE's third-party tokenization plans, putting issuer consent at the centre of the SEC exemption debate** — Of the 62 companies originally proposed for tokenization by OKXICE, the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange venture, 56 have formally objected, including all seven Magnificent Seven companies alongside Walmart, JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Eli Lilly, Boeing and McDonald's, and 11 further companies outside the original list have also raised objections, leaving only Strategy, Robinhood, Coinbase, Circle, Securitize and BitGo not objecting; the dispute is over consent, because OKXICE would tokenize shares through an unaffiliated third party, while TSV on Canton tokenizes only with issuer sponsorship through Fairmint, the SEC-registered transfer agent behind its first Canton Strategic Holdings trades, and Nasdaq has separately opposed TSV's framework in favour of an issuer-centric approach inside existing regulated markets (CryptoFrontNews)
- **Live MainNet activity jumps to 11.00 TPS as rewards over the last 24 hours climb to 9.9 million CC** — CantonNews' live MainNet counter on November 14 reads current activity at 11.00 TPS, up sharply from the 1.00 TPS recorded earlier today, with rewards over the last 24 hours at 9.9 million CC, up from 9.2 million in the previous edition, alongside total transactions at 603.0 million, total parties at 946.8K and total burned at 6.03B CC (CantonNews)
- **Circle reports about $47.99 million held in Canton Coin in its latest quarterly disclosure** — Circle's reported digital-asset holdings totalled about $133 million as of September 30, including about $47.99 million in Canton Coin and about $45.88 million in HYPE, with the HYPE position up more than fivefold from a year earlier; the figure is a treasury disclosure by a company that also operates on Canton and was named in the latest MainNet validator allocation notice, not an announcement of a new purchase (CoinNewsify)
- **Canton app fees total $7,829 over 24 hours, with Temple generating $7,113 of the total** — DefiLlama's November 14 fees ranking puts Canton app fees at $7,829 in the last 24 hours, up from $7,118 a day earlier, with $54,943 over the last seven days and $256,512 over the last 30 days, a weekly change of -0.36%; Temple accounts for $7,113 of the daily total and Cantex for $1,021, while Pool Party recorded no fees in the window (DefiLlama)

items.title: Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking enforcement on-chain under CIP-0127
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 9:12 AM ET)
- **Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking enforcement on-chain under CIP-0127** — The Canton documentation now details how governance locks will work from Splice 0.10.0: CIP-0105 requires Super Validators to lock a percentage of their aggregate lifetime rewards to keep their weight, CIP-0116 requires each Featured App provider to lock a minimum amount of Canton Coin to gain and keep featured status, and CIP-0127 is the functional specification that moves enforcement of both onto the ledger itself; every lock must hold at least 10,000 CC, Super Validator locks vest over 365.25 days after an unlock while Featured App locks vest over 60 days, and wallet providers have been asked to expand memo fields to 1,000 characters because lock data is encoded in the transfer memo in compatibility mode (Canton Network Docs)
- **SBI Holdings and Cambodia's central bank plan a tokenized government-bond trial on Canton** — SBI Holdings and the National Bank of Cambodia signed a memorandum of understanding on November 13 for a proof of concept in tokenized Cambodian government bonds, with Canton planned as the network and the aim of making bond investment accessible in smaller amounts through local financial institutions; the central bank will register and manage bondholder information, SBI Bank (Cambodia) will work on technical verification of tokenization and transfers, and SBI Digital Practice will build and operate the trial environment, with interim results and a demonstration planned for the Black Swan Summit in Phnom Penh on November 15–16, and a separate memorandum the same day covers a Japan–Cambodia remittance proof of concept; the bond work is a planned trial, not a live issuance (CantonNews)
- **CapConnect+ seeks a Super Validator role under CIP-0131 to settle commercial paper and its cash payment together on Canton** — The proposal, in a vote that opened November 10 with Tradeweb as sponsor and MPCH as endorser, offers a maximum of five reward weight units tied to delivery and adoption milestones, starting with at least $100 million in aggregate commercial-paper issuance settling both the asset and the cash on Canton within six months of approval, then cumulative milestones at $1 billion, $5 billion and $10 billion; the existing CapConnect+ platform, developed in collaboration with Walmart, has facilitated more than $46.11 billion in issuance since full production began in early 2025 on existing settlement infrastructure, which is not Canton volume, and the public document does not identify the anchor issuer for the first Canton transactions (CantonNews)
- **Canton Foundation launches an official Daml 3 developer certification, with free self-paced courses and a $150 exam** — The Canton Developer Certification, launched November 10, pairs free self-paced courses with a certification exam costing $150 per session and is based on Daml 3 and Canton 3.x, the current network stack; it validates practical mastery of Daml's authorization and privacy principles — controlling who may act on a contract and who may access its terms — and gives existing Daml 2 developers a migration path onto the single current platform, with Foundation chief operating officer Amanda Martin framing it as a common professional standard for building in regulated markets (HTX)
- **Canton Coin spot prices widen to 9.06% apart across exchanges, with only a thin best route after fees** — A November 14, 14:02 UTC scan found Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.07571 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.082569 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, wider than the 8.19% spread recorded earlier today; the best spot route, buying on Bybit and selling on Kraken, paid only 0.11% after taker fees, about $1.05 on $1,000 at the best book prices, with the transfer status between the exchanges unknown, the best futures route, long WhiteBIT perpetuals against short Lighter perpetuals, paid 0.73% after fees, and no route with a confirmed open transfer was worth taking (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton Coin futures open interest eases further to $38.01 million, with liquidations almost absent
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest eases further to $38.01 million, with liquidations almost absent** — Aggregated CC futures open interest has fallen 6.15% over three days to $38.01 million, near the bottom of its 30-day range, while 24-hour liquidations totalled only $14.68K and funding stayed neutral at 0.0054% per eight hours; on Binance, accounts are now 51.8% long and 48.2% short, down from a 30-day average long share of 57.8%, suggesting longs are closing rather than shorts building (CoinStats)
- **Splice 0.10.0 caps Scan and Super Validator endpoints and moves local deployments to Postgres 18** — The release bounds various Scan and SV App endpoints at a maxItems limit of 1,000, with larger requests rejected, sets Postgres 18 as the default for Docker Compose validator, Super Validator and localnet deployments, and binds LocalNet host ports to 127.0.0.1 instead of all interfaces; Canton 3.7 adds protocol version 37, which requires a Logical Synchronizer Upgrade to adopt (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton's $370.5 billion in represented assets is all Broadridge repo recordkeeping, a review clarifies** — RWA.xyz data as of November 12 counts $370.5 billion of represented real-world assets on Canton, 88.6% of all represented value it tracks, all in Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo, while showing no tokens distributed to investor wallets; Broadridge itself reports DLR processed an average of $345 billion a day in repo transactions in October, $7.6 trillion for the month, which is production settlement volume rather than distributed token holdings (Daniil Kozin)

items.title: Canton selected to support a three-state RISE benefits pilot planned for the first quarter of 2027
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 7:12 AM ET)
- **Canton selected to support a three-state RISE benefits pilot planned for the first quarter of 2027** — The pilot would combine public benefit programs into scheduled payments while applying spending rules and limiting data access, demonstrating a use beyond financial markets; it is planned for the first quarter of 2027 but requires federal approval, and the participating states and programs have not been disclosed, so it is a planned pilot rather than confirmed large-scale adoption (CoinMarketCap)
- **Canton Strategic chief flags MEV costs for tokenized stocks, with privacy pitched as a safeguard** — Canton Strategic Holdings chief executive Mark Wendland warned on November 13 that maximum extractable value can create hidden costs when validators prioritize transactions, and said Canton's privacy protections and rules against paid transaction ordering are designed to reduce that exposure; the warning highlights execution quality as a live design concern for tokenized markets, and the report also noted tokenized share trades on Canton completed on November 4 (CoinMarketCap)
- **Rome Protocol's Ostia brings EVM tools to Canton DevNet, in an unaudited test release** — Ostia, an Ethereum-compatible chain from Rome Protocol, began running on Canton's developer test network on October 22, with the report appearing on November 12; it supports wrapped Canton Coin, but the release remains unaudited and experimental and is not evidence of production adoption (CoinMarketCap)
- **The Hub reports 1,000 members on Canton, combining creator content with tradable community tickets** — The Hub says its platform combines creator content, live rooms and tradable community tickets on Canton and has announced 1,000 members; the figure is a milestone reported by the project itself and follows an earlier SprintFAM creator-network partnership, although the posts do not establish how many sign-ups came from that collaboration (CantonNews)

items.title: Console Wallet reports full service restoration after a precautionary suspension
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 6:42 AM ET)
- **Console Wallet reports full service restoration after a precautionary suspension** — Console said in its November 12 update that it was fully operational after a precautionary suspension following suspicious activity the previous week; the restoration is the project's reported status and the short notice does not provide a full incident analysis (CantonNews)
- **Cantex adds optional two-factor authentication for actions that move assets or grant permissions** — The wallet update covers withdrawals, transfers, pre-approvals and bridge transactions, adding another check beyond the initial sign-in that users can choose to apply to those actions (CantonNews)
- **Two Canton development proposals pass their votes, for Python tooling and a protected co-validator** — Obsidian Systems' 1.27 million CC proposal to generate Python classes from compiled Daml packages passed and was merged, including delivery and a year of maintenance, and Financial Privacy Inc.'s 4.59 million CC proposal to build a Canton participant inside a trusted execution environment also passed and was merged, covering DevNet and TestNet development, a reference deployment and maintenance; neither vote establishes a completed production service (CantonNews)
- **Digital Asset has 30 open roles as of November 14, with posted pay from $140,000 to $220,000** — None of the roles are listed as remote and 36% are senior level, with Scala, Kubernetes and Python the most requested skills and the highest posted range, $180,000 to $220,000, for a Principal Product Manager for the Canton Network Ecosystem (Landed Jobs)
